description: This file defines the DebugRuntime class for CLI debugging of AST and Compiler runtimes in the JmesPath namespace, including methods for tokenizing, parsing, and dumping code representations.

classes.name: DebugRuntime
classes.description: Provides CLI debugging information for the AST and Compiler runtimes, including tokenization, parsing, and code dumping functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes DebugRuntime with a runtime callable and optional output stream.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes debugging depending on whether the runtime is a CompilerRuntime or interpreted.

methods.name: debugInterpreted
methods.description: Handles debugging for interpreted runtime expressions.

methods.name: debugCompiled
methods.description: Handles debugging for compiled runtime expressions, including dumping compiled code.

methods.name: dumpTokens
methods.description: Tokenizes and outputs the tokens of an expression.

methods.name: dumpAst
methods.description: Parses and outputs the AST of an expression.

methods.name: dumpCompiledCode
methods.description: Outputs the generated compiled PHP code for an expression.

methods.name: debugCallback
methods.description: Executes a debug function, outputs expression, tokens, AST, data, result, and timing information.
